source_sql:
-- B-5. LATERAL / CROSS APPLY（12c+）：部門ごとの高給上位2名
SELECT d.department_name, t.last_name, t.salary
FROM   departments d
CROSS  APPLY (SELECT e.last_name, e.salary
              FROM   employees e
              WHERE  e.department_id = d.department_id
              ORDER  BY e.salary DESC
              FETCH  FIRST 2 ROWS ONLY) t

java.sql: /* B-5. LATERAL / CROSS APPLY（12c+）：部門ごとの高給上位2名 */ SELECT d.department_name, t.last_name, t.salary FROM departments d INNER JOIN LATERAL (SELECT e.last_name, e.salary FROM employees e WHERE e.department_id = d.department_id ORDER BY e.salary DESC NULLS FIRST FETCH FIRST 2 ROWS ONLY) AS t
